inspect.combat.block.description: Block prevents incoming damage before HP is lost. Usually, block is removed at the end of its owner's turn.
inspect.combat.block.name: Block
inspect.player.energy.description: Energy is spent to play cards belonging to this actor. It refreshes at the start of your turn.
inspect.player.energy.name: Energy
inspect.player.health.description: When this actor reaches 0 HP, they are defeated.
inspect.player.health.name: Health
inspect.player.hp.name: HP
inspect.player.no_effects.description: This actor currently has no statuses, stance effects, or temporary combat modifiers.
inspect.player.no_effects.name: No active effects
inspect.status.unknown: No status description has been added yet.
status.burn.description: Placeholder for fire damage over time. The exact rule will be added later.
status.burn.name: Burn
status.dexterity.description: Each stack of Dexterity increases block gained from cards and effects by 1.
status.dexterity.name: Dexterity
status.frail.description: Gains 25% less block from cards. In this build, prepared as a future modifier status.
status.frail.name: Frail
status.free_next_card.description: The next played card with cost greater than 0 costs 0 energy. Decreases by 1 after triggering.
status.free_next_card.name: Free Next Card
status.poison.description: At the end of its turn, this creature takes damage equal to its Poison. Then Poison decreases by 1.
status.poison.name: Poison
status.regeneration.description: Restores health according to its effect rules. Prepared for future cards in this build.
status.regeneration.name: Regeneration
status.stance_ash.description: Gain +2 block from cards and effects, but deal 15% less damage. Removed when entering another stance.
status.stance_ash.name: Ash Stance
status.stance_flame.description: Deal 25% more damage, but take 25% more damage. Removed when entering another stance.
status.stance_flame.name: Flame Stance
status.stance_smoke.description: Take 25% less damage. Removed when entering another stance.
status.stance_smoke.name: Smoke Stance
status.strength.description: Each stack of Strength increases attack damage dealt by 1. For example, with 3 Strength, an attack that deals 6 damage becomes 9 damage before target modifiers.
status.strength.name: Strength
status.vulnerable.description: This creature takes 50% more damage from attacks. Decreases by 1 at the end of its owner's turn.
status.vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
status.weak.description: This creature's attacks deal 25% less damage. Decreases by 1 at the end of its owner's turn.
status.weak.name: Weak
